name: Milkybar Moosha
ingredients_raw: Nougat + Caramel (70%) (Sugar, Liquid glucose, Hydrogenated vegetable fats, Malt extract, *Milk solids (3.7%), Emulsifiers (471 and Soya Lecithin), Acidity regulator (330), Stabilizer (501(i)), lodized salt, Nature - Identical flavouring substances and Artificial (Vanilla) flavouring substances) and MILKYBAR^ Coating (30%) (*Milk solids (10.6%), Sugar, Hydrogenated vegetable fats, Fractionated vegetable fat, Emulsifier (Soya lecithin) and Nature-Identical flavouring substances). Allergens Note: Contains Barley, Milk, Sesame, Soy and Wheat.
